#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iomanip>

class InputReader {
private:
    std::istream& stream;
    std::vector<char> buffer;
    size_t ptr;
    size_t len;

public:
    InputReader(std::istream& s) : stream(s), buffer(1024), ptr(0), len(0) {}

private:
    int read() {
        if (len == -1) throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        if (ptr >= len) {
            ptr = 0;
            stream.read(buffer.data(), buffer.size());
            len = stream.gcount();
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[ptr++]);
    }

    bool isSpace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }

public:
    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int val = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpace(c));
        return val * sign;
    }
};

class TaskG {
private:
    static const int MAX_N = 1 << 21;
    static std::vector<double> cs;
    static std::vector<double> sn;
    static std::vector<double> csi;
    static std::vector<double> sni;

    static void initializeConstants() {
        static bool initialized = false;
        if (!initialized) {
            cs.resize(MAX_N);
            sn.resize(MAX_N);
            csi.resize(MAX_N);
            sni.resize(MAX_N);
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / MAX_N;
                cs[i] = cos(angle);
                sn[i] = sin(angle);
                csi[i] = cos(-angle);
                sni[i] = sin(-angle);
            }
            initialized = true;
        }
    }

    static void performFFT(std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reversebits(static_cast<unsigned int>(i)) >> shift;
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(re[i], re[j]);
                std::swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            int step = MAX_N / len;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0, w = 0; j < half; j++, w += step) {
                    double wr = inverse ? csi[w] : cs[w];
                    double wi = inverse ? sni[w] : sn[w];
                    double x = re[i + j + half] * wr - im[i + j + half] * wi;
                    double y = re[i + j + half] * wi + im[i + j + half] * wr;
                    re[i + j + half] = re[i + j] - x;
                    im[i + j + half] = im[i + j] - y;
                    re[i + j] += x;
                    im[i + j] += y;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inverse) {
            double invN = 1.0 / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] *= invN;
                im[i] *= invN;
            }
        }
    }

public:
    static std::vector<int> multiplyPolynomial(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = std::max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));

        std::vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> aImag(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(a.size()); i++) {
            int val = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            aImag[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(aReal, aImag, false);

        std::vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> bImag(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(b.size()); i++) {
            int val = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            bImag[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(bReal, bImag, false);

        std::vector<double> resReal1(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> resImag1(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> resReal2(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> resImag2(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

            double ar1 = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai1 = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double ar2 = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai2 = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) * 0.5;

            double br1 = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi1 = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double br2 = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi2 = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * 0.5;

            resReal1[i] = ar1 * br1 - ai1 * bi1 - ar2 * bi2 - ai2 * br2;
            resImag1[i] = ar1 * bi1 + ai1 * br1 + ar2 * br2 - ai2 * bi2;
            resReal2[i] = ar1 * br2 - ai1 * bi2 + ar2 * br1 - ai2 * bi1;
            resImag2[i] = ar1 * bi2 + ai1 * br2 + ar2 * bi1 + ai2 * br1;
        }

        performFFT(resReal1, resImag1, true);
        performFFT(resReal2, resImag2, true);

        std::vector<int> result(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long aa = llround(resReal1[i]);
            long long bb = llround(resReal2[i]);
            long long cc = llround(resImag1[i]);
            result[i] = static_cast<int>((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return result;
    }

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, std::ostream& out) {
        const int MOD = 998244353;
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        std::vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            v[in.nextInt()] = 1;
        }
        std::vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                ans = multiplyPolynomial(ans, v, MOD);
            }
            p >>= 1;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyPolynomial(v, v, MOD);
        }
        long long result = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            result = (result + static_cast<long long>(x) * x) % MOD;
        }
        out << result << std::endl;
    }
};

std::vector<double> TaskG::cs(MAX_N);
std::vector<double> TaskG::sn(MAX_N);
std::vector<double> TaskG::csi(MAX_N);
std::vector<double> TaskG::sni(MAX_N);

int main() {
    TaskG::initializeConstants();
    TaskG solver;
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    solver.solve(1, in, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
